errors.wrong_password: That password doesn't match. Try again.
errors.wrong_recovery_key: This recovery key belongs to a different journal.
errors.invalid_recovery_phrase: Check the key: it should be 24 words from the list, in the same order.
errors.password_too_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.recovery_mismatch: The words don't match. Check your written key and try again.
errors.throttled: Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.unsupported_format: This journal was saved by a newer version of the app.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.duplicate_tag_name: A tag with this name already exists.
errors.not_a_backup: This is not a Mossbook backup file.
errors.unsupported_backup: This backup comes from a newer version of the app.
errors.backup_corrupted: The backup file is damaged or was changed.
errors.backup_too_large: The file is too large to be a Mossbook backup.
errors.io: Could not read or write the file.
errors.inbox_unavailable: Quick entry without the password works after the journal is unlocked once in this version of the app.
errors.report_too_large: The report is too large. Choose a shorter period or fewer entries.
errors.report_password_short: The PDF password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.report_password_chars: The PDF password contains characters PDF files do not support (such as emoji). Use letters, digits and punctuation.
errors.report_failed: Could not create the PDF file. Please try again.
errors.biometric_unavailable: Fingerprint unlock is not available on this device.
errors.biometric_lockout: Too many fingerprint attempts. Enter your password or try again in a moment.
errors.biometric_failed: Could not check your fingerprint. Enter your password.
errors.device_key_invalidated: The fingerprints on this phone changed, so fingerprint unlock turned off. Enter your password. You can turn it on again in Settings.
errors.device_key_rejected: The fingerprint did not open the journal, so fingerprint unlock turned off. Enter your password.
errors.device_unlock_off: Fingerprint unlock is off. Enter your password.

welcome.title: Welcome to Mossbook
welcome.body: A place for your notes: how you feel, what happened, fears and sleep. Everything stays on this device, encrypted. No account, no server, nothing is sent anywhere.
welcome.disclaimer: Mossbook is not a substitute for professional help. If you are in danger, call 112.

password.title: Set a password
password.body: The password opens your journal. Pick one you don't use anywhere else. A few ordinary words are easiest to remember.

phrase.title: Your recovery key
phrase.body: These 24 words open the journal if you forget your password. Write them on paper and keep it somewhere safe.
phrase.warning: If you lose both your password and this key, nobody (not even us) can recover your entries.
phrase.saved: I have stored the key somewhere safe

confirm.title: Let's check the key
confirm.body: Type the words at these positions, copying them from your paper.

lock.title: Your journal is locked
lock.subtitle: Enter your password to open the journal.

recover.title: Recover access
recover.body: Enter the 24 words of your recovery key and set a new password. The key stays the same.

timeline.title: Your journal
timeline.unreadable: Some saved data could not be read ({count}). Your other entries are safe.
timeline.emptyHint: Tap + to note how you are. It takes a few seconds.

field.sensitiveHint: On the timeline show only the type and time; reveal the content on tap.

entry.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.

quick.title: Quick entry
quick.chooseKind: What do you want to note?
quick.done: Saved. You can complete it later.
quick.lockedDone: Saved. The entry will appear in your journal after you unlock it.
quick.lockedHint: You can add an entry without the password. Nobody can read earlier entries.

tags.title: Tags
tags.name: Name
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete this tag? It will be removed from all entries.
tags.mergeConfirm: Merge? Entries with this tag will get the chosen tag.
tags.duplicate: A tag with this name already exists.

help.open: Plan for a hard moment / phones
help.title: When it's hard
help.intro: You don't have to cope alone. You can call someone or do a short exercise.
help.noCountry: We don't have numbers for your country yet. In the European Union, call 112 in an emergency.
help.callFailed: Could not start the call. Dial it yourself: {number}

exercise.done: Well done. Stay for a moment with how you feel now.
exercise.intro478: Breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds, hold for 7, breathe out slowly through your mouth for 8. Four times.
exercise.introBox: Breathe in, hold, breathe out, hold: 4 seconds each. Four times.
exercise.introGrounding: Look around and name what you notice, one step at a time. Take your time.

plan.title: Plan for a hard moment
plan.intro: Prepare it at a calmer time. It will be at hand when things get hard.
plan.self_coping: What I can do on my own
plan.calming_people_places: People and places that calm me
plan.safe_environment: How to keep my surroundings safe
plan.name: Name

settings.title: Settings
settings.immediately: As soon as you leave the app

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: A backup is a single encrypted file. It opens with the password or recovery key from the day it was made.
backup.sameVault: This is a backup of this same journal.
backup.mode: What to do with your current entries
backup.merge: Merge: add what is missing, keep newer versions
backup.replace: Replace: the journal becomes exactly the backup
backup.replaceWarning: Entries that are not in the backup will be deleted.
backup.restoreIntro: Have a .mossbook file from another device? Choose it and open it with its password or recovery key. The journal keeps the backup's password and key.
backup.autoToggle: Make a copy when the journal locks (once a day, the last 7 are kept)
backup.autoNone: No automatic copy yet. The first one is made the next time the journal locks.
backup.autoFailed: The last automatic copy could not be saved. Your journal is unchanged.
backup.autoHint: These copies help if the journal file gets damaged or something is deleted by mistake. They stay on this device, so also save a copy somewhere else, such as a USB stick or another computer.
backup.lastExportNever: No backup saved by you yet.

password.title: Change password
password.changed: Password changed. Your recovery key stays the same.
password.oldBackups: Older backups still open with the previous password.
password.autoReplaced: Automatic copies on this device were replaced with one that opens with the new password.

destroy.title: Delete all data
destroy.intro: Your journal, tags, plan and settings will be permanently deleted from this device. Backups saved elsewhere stay.
destroy.question: Delete all data for good? This cannot be undone.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.chartHint: Average rating of each day, from 1 (very hard) to 5 (very good).
patterns.empty: No mood ratings in this period yet. They will appear here once you add entries with a rating.
patterns.note: These are only your notes shown over time, not an assessment of your health.

report.title: Report for a therapist
report.intro: Choose a period and entry types. You will see a preview before anything is saved.
report.warning: The PDF file is not encrypted. Anyone who opens it can read these entries. Save it only somewhere safe and delete it when it is no longer needed.
report.protect: Protect the PDF with a password
report.protectHint: The file will require a password to open. Send the password separately.
report.sensitiveProtected: The report includes entries marked as difficult, so password protection is on. You can turn it off.
report.passwordShort: The PDF password must be at least 12 characters.
report.passwordMismatch: The PDF passwords do not match.
report.passwordHelp: Do not use your journal password here. We do not store this password — if you lose it, generate the report again.
report.copied: Password copied. The clipboard clears after 60 seconds.
report.copyFailed: Could not copy the password. Select it and copy it manually.
report.savedEncrypted: Encrypted PDF saved. Send the password through a different channel than the file.
report.passwordWarning: The password protects the file, not the conversation. If you send the password in the same message as the PDF, the protection is only apparent.
report.empty: No entries match in the chosen period.
report.footer: Mossbook · this file is not encrypted

nightmare.intro: Write down the nightmare, then a new version of it, calmer or with a different ending. You can rehearse it in your mind and mark when you do.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.hint: The color of a day shows its average mood rating: the darker, the better the day was.

insights.title: Overviews
insights.notEnough: Overviews appear once the chosen period has at least 14 entries (now: {count}).
insights.triggersHint: Triggers written down at least twice in the same words.
insights.sleep: Mood and the previous night's sleep
insights.sleepHint: Average mood rating on days after a night of that sleep quality.
insights.weekday: Mood and day of the week
insights.strategiesHint: Difference in intensity before and after, for strategies used at least twice.
insights.none: Nothing repeats in this period yet.

unsaved.title: Unsaved entry
unsaved.body: {kind}, {time}. Mossbook kept it when the journal locked.
unsaved.discardConfirm: Discard this entry? This cannot be undone.

about.title: About
about.checkHint: Opens the releases page in your browser. The app itself never connects to the internet.
about.old: This version is more than 3 months old. A newer one may be available.
about.watch: You can get notified of new versions on GitHub: Watch → Custom → Releases.
about.legal: Mossbook is free software under the GNU GPL version 3 or later. It comes with no warranty, to the extent permitted by law, so keep your own backups. It is not a medical device: it does not diagnose, recommend treatment or assess your health.

recoveryCheck.title: Check your recovery key
recoveryCheck.intro: Type the 24 words you wrote down to make sure they open this journal. Nothing changes.
recoveryCheck.label: Your 24 words
recoveryCheck.ok: These words open your journal. Keep them somewhere safe.
recoveryCheck.wrong: These words do not open this journal. Compare each word with your note.

exportJson.title: Readable copy (JSON)
exportJson.intro: All your entries, tags, plan and settings in one JSON file that other programs can read. Your data is yours to take anywhere.
exportJson.warning: The JSON file is not encrypted. Anyone who opens it can read your whole journal. Save it only somewhere safe and delete it when it is no longer needed.
exportJson.question: Save a file that is not encrypted?

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint unlock
fingerprint.intro: Open the journal with your fingerprint instead of the password. The key stays in the phone’s secure chip and works only on this device.
fingerprint.password: Enter your password to turn it on
fingerprint.on: On. You can open the journal with your fingerprint or your password.
fingerprint.disabled: Fingerprint unlock is off. You can open the journal with your password.
fingerprint.reminder: Your password and the 24-word recovery key are still the only way to open the journal on another phone or from a backup. Keep your password well in mind.
fingerprint.enrollHint: This phone has a fingerprint sensor, but no fingerprint is set up. Add one in the phone’s settings (Security → Fingerprint), then come back here.

voice.title: Voice note
voice.hint: Up to 5 minutes. The recording stays on this device, encrypted like the rest of the journal.
voice.removed: The recording will leave the entry when you save it.
voice.limit: Five minutes have passed, so the recording stopped by itself.
voice.denied: Mossbook has no access to the microphone. You can allow it in the system settings.
voice.unsupported: Recording is not available on this device.
voice.failed: The recording did not work. Please try again.
voice.playFailed: The recording could not be played.
